method: Pass/rush counts inferred from totalPPA/ppa. A count is accepted only if both that ratio and successRate*play_count are integer-consistent. Cumulative rate = sum(successful plays) / sum(eligible plays), FBS opponents only.
caveats: Matching integer counts validates internal source consistency, not independent proof of Fourth and Short methodology.
API query excluded garbage-time plays; source pass/rush eligibility rules may differ from public third-party displays.
No weekly values are published when any available FBS game lacks verified counts.
No changes to original four-unit/overall ratings.
